## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated; no live API calls in tests
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, `.env.example`) if behaviour, commands or env vars changed
- [ ] No secrets, real keys or credentialed URLs in code, fixtures or output
- [ ] No fabricated data; missing values are `null` / UNKNOWN
- [ ] Read-only: no signing, private-key handling or transaction submission
- [ ] No hype, investment advice or price predictions in code, prompts, docs or output
